product.title: Crue Pull-Down Single-Handle Kitchen Faucet
product.description: Pair distinctive style with dependable performance in the KOHLER Crue pull-down kitchen sink faucet, a study in clean, sophisticated design that adapts effortlessly to nearly any kitchen style. Its arched spout and single lever handle simplify installation and everyday use, while a three-function sprayhead provides versatile functionality.
features: Finishes include black, chrome, brass, gold, and stainless
DockNetik® secure docking system locks sprayhead into place when not in use
Three-function pull-down sprayhead with touch control allows you to switch between aerated stream, ring spray and Boost technology
MasterClean™ sprayface features an easy-to-clean surface that withstands mineral buildup and maximizes spray performance
High-arch spout offers vertical clearance for tall cookware and pitchers
Premium metal construction for durability and reliability
KOHLER finishes resist corrosion and tarnishing
Single-hole or three-hole installation (escutcheon plate included)
